entries.title: What you ask about a page opens beside it
entries.body:
Ask about a document, a pull request or a plugin's page from the bar at
its foot, and the conversation opens **beside the page**, where you carry
it on. It stays with that page: leave and it's out of the way, come back
and it's there. `\` opens and closes it.

entries.title: A foot along the bottom, and a sidebar you can hide
entries.body:
A line along the bottom of the window shows which crew are working: press
one to go and watch it. Its first button hides the sidebar, for the page's
whole width; hidden, it says how many things need you.

entries.title: ⌘K does things where you are
entries.body:
On a mission, conversation or pull request, **⌘K** lists what you can do to
it before you type: park, archive, resolve, dock. Every place is in it too,
plugins' and Settings' among them.

entries.title: Plugins and updates, in Settings
entries.body:
Add, update and remove plugins from **Settings › Plugins**. ws looks for a
new release once a day, and **Settings › About** upgrades it.

entries.title: The daemon keeps your silos
entries.body:
Silos stay synced without `ws silo watch` open: the daemon mirrors each
as files change, and catches up when it restarts. **Runs** shows how each
stands and its last hook's output.

entries.title: ws says what's new when it's upgraded
entries.body:
After an upgrade, a few lines on what's new, once. They stay on
**Settings › About**.
